scripts.api:start: sh -c 'PORT=${BACKEND_PORT:-8000}; pids=$(lsof -tiTCP:$PORT -sTCP:LISTEN || true); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo "Stopping stale processes on :$PORT"; kill $pids || true; sleep 1; fi; pids=$(lsof -tiTCP:$PORT -sTCP:LISTEN || true); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo "Force-stopping processes on :$PORT"; kill -9 $pids || true; fi; echo "Starting backend on http://127.0.0.1:$PORT"; conda run -n route_minds uvicorn api.app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port $PORT'
scripts.api:stop: sh -c 'PORT=${BACKEND_PORT:-8000}; pids=$(lsof -tiTCP:$PORT -sTCP:LISTEN || true); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo "Stopping backend on :$PORT"; kill $pids || true; sleep 1; pids=$(lsof -tiTCP:$PORT -sTCP:LISTEN || true); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo "Force-stopping backend on :$PORT"; kill -9 $pids || true; fi; else echo "No backend process found on :$PORT"; fi'
scripts.api:restart: bun run api:stop && bun run api:start
scripts.api:status: sh -c 'PORT=${BACKEND_PORT:-8000}; lsof -nP -iTCP:$PORT -sTCP:LISTEN || echo "No backend process listening on :$PORT"'
